criteria.finding: The v1.1.10 publisher workflow AAB is pinned by SHA-256 and size. Bundletool 1.18.3 produced an installable universal APK from that AAB; the derived APK uses the public laboratory fixture signature and is identified separately from a store-signed production APK.

The exact release payload reports app.metanet.explorer 1.1.10 (66) and follows the ordinary production first-run flow. Re-signing the universal derivative changes Android signer identity, so signer-dependent behavior is outside this run.
The application ran from cleared package state in the dedicated TPNIL_API_36 emulator. The AVD definition, Android properties, toolchain and installed package state are retained.
The ordinary first-run path requires phone-number verification before the wallet service boundary becomes available. No personal phone number or undisclosed pre-provisioned identity was introduced.
Wallet initialization did not pass the ordinary phone verification boundary, so controlled fixture funding was not applicable to this run.

Native launch, package identity, the first-run verification barrier, browser navigation to the pinned ToDo webroot and its explicit wallet-required result were observed. Wallet-backed V002 through V008 remained blocked by initialization.
One clean Android execution is retained. A second execution requires an admitted activation fixture or supported pre-provisioned wallet state.

evaluate.finding: P2PPSR owner expressly accepts retained submission terms v2.1.0 for the identified v1.1.10 AAB on behalf of the stated author/rights holder. TPNIL evaluations are authorized under that grant. The owner subsequently authorizes broad non-commercial TPNIL-related use, including education, research, experimentation and public mirroring; see the recorded scope clarification. Existing grants remain intact.

retain.finding: The accepted grant permits continued retention and hosting of the identified submission for TPNIL reproduction for the full duration of controlled rights, surviving withdrawal or replacement. The owner subsequently authorizes broad non-commercial TPNIL-related use, including education, research, experimentation and public mirroring; see the recorded scope clarification. Existing grants remain intact.

redistribute.finding: The accepted grant permits everyone to mirror and distribute exact accepted artifact copies with the same permissions, solely to reproduce TPNIL evaluations and verify their results. Resale and unrelated distribution are outside this grant. The owner subsequently authorizes broad non-commercial TPNIL-related use, including education, research, experimentation and public mirroring; see the recorded scope clarification. Existing grants remain intact.

publishResults.finding: The accepted grant permits publication of findings and necessary supporting evidence for the identified submission, including unfavorable results.

announceParticipation.finding: The company owner accepts the participation terms on the company's behalf. Truthful P2PPSR/Metanet Explorer participation announcements are authorized; P2PPSR also operates the laboratory and that affiliation must remain clear.
